# PetSmart

> PetSmart is a comprehensive pet retailer offering supplies, food, services, and adoption across multiple pet categories with loyalty rewards and same-day delivery options.

PetSmart operates as a leading pet supplies and services destination, featuring product categories for dogs, cats, fish, birds, and reptiles alongside professional grooming, boarding, training, and veterinary care through its services portal. The company operates physical store locations across the US and Canada with digital shopping and fulfillment options.

## Key Topics

- Pet Supplies
- Pet Food
- Pet Accessories
- Treats Rewards Loyalty Program
- Same-Day Delivery
- Pet Services

## Shopping & Product Categories

- [Homepage](https://www.petsmart.com): PetSmart homepage featuring pet supplies, food, services and store locator
- [Dog Supplies](https://www.petsmart.com/dog): Dog supplies including food, treats, crates, and grooming items
- [Cat Supplies](https://www.petsmart.com/cat): Cat supplies including food, litter, furniture, and wellness essentials
- [Fish Supplies](https://www.petsmart.com/fish): Fish supplies including aquariums, equipment, and live fish
- [Bird Supplies](https://www.petsmart.com/bird): Bird supplies including cages, food, toys, and live birds
- [Reptile Supplies](https://www.petsmart.com/reptile): Reptile supplies including terrariums, feeders, and heating equipment
- [Shop by Brand](https://www.petsmart.com/shop-by-brand): Browse pet products by brand directory with alphabetical filtering

## Services & Professional Care

- [PetSmart Services](https://services.petsmart.com): Pet services including grooming, boarding, training, and veterinary care
- [Pet Pharmacy](https://www.petsmart.com/pharmacy): Pet pharmacy with prescription medications and flea/tick prevention
- [Pet Adoption](https://www.petsmart.com/pet-adoption): Pet adoption services for dogs, cats, and small pets

## Deals & Promotions

- [Sales & Promotions](https://www.petsmart.com/sale): Sales and promotions for pet supplies across all categories
- [Same-Day Delivery & In-Store Pickup](https://www.petsmart.com/sale/same-day-delivery-in-store-pick-up): Shop sale items with same-day delivery and in-store pickup options
- [Gift Cards](https://www.petsmart.com/gift-cards): PetSmart gift cards in various themes and amounts ($25-$500)
- [Outdoor Adventure Shop](https://www.petsmart.com/featured-shops/outdoor-shop-for-pets): Outdoor pet apparel and gear for adventures with your pet

## Loyalty & Account Management

- [Treats Rewards Loyalty Program](https://www.petsmart.com/treats-rewards): Treats Rewards loyalty program with tiered membership benefits
- [Sign In](https://www.petsmart.com/sign-in): Account sign-in page with Treats Rewards loyalty program access
- [Create Account](https://www.petsmart.com/create-account): Account creation page with Treats Rewards enrollment
- [Order Search](https://www.petsmart.com/account/order-search): Order tracking and search functionality for customer accounts

## Store & Location Services

- [Store Locator](https://www.petsmart.com/store-locator): Store locator tool to find nearby PetSmart locations

## Pet Care Resources

- [Learning Center](https://www.petsmart.com/learning-center): Pet care guides and advice for dogs, cats, and other companion animals
